shots.heading: 01  ·  00–06
shots.direction: Low tracking shot. Two pairs of shoes cross alternating sunlight and shadow. Reflections enter a shop window before we see their faces. Uneven footsteps; distant rotor hum. Small location text: Freetown, United Cities.

shots.heading: 02  ·  06–15
shots.direction: Waist-up travelling two-shot, Bai on the left. She leans into his eyeline while Zei keeps looking ahead. A window mullion briefly separates their reflections. First exchange.

shots.heading: 03  ·  15–23
shots.direction: Zei in three-quarter profile. His hand counts off one point; Bai’s reflection raises an eyebrow behind him. Hold her response a beat longer than he expects.

shots.heading: 04  ·  23–33
shots.direction: Wide lateral track. The street opens into mismatched stone, concrete and glass. Zei explains their shared break. Their footfalls accidentally settle into the same rhythm.

shots.heading: 05  ·  33–41
shots.direction: Bai’s close-up, then a cut to Zei at “efficient.” Her small smile; his entirely earnest nod. No graphs or floating equations. The comedy lives in their faces.

shots.heading: 06  ·  41–49
shots.direction: Over Zei’s shoulder. He looks up at the unfamiliar skyline; one small copter passes. A distant grey-and-purple wall stays in the background. The camera eases upward with him.

shots.heading: 07  ·  49–59
shots.direction: Reverse close-up: Bai has been watching him, not the skyline. Her expression softens. After “What?”, Zei glances upward again, caught. Allow quiet between the lines.

shots.heading: 08  ·  59–67
shots.direction: Return to the two-shot. Zei finally looks directly at Bai when he asks his question. Stop the lateral camera movement. Their first uninterrupted moment of attention.

shots.heading: 09  ·  67–74
shots.direction: Matching close-ups. Zei asks about the match. Bai answers without a grin, holding eye contact. At 70 seconds the music drops away; let the admission stay small.

shots.heading: 10  ·  74–78
shots.direction: Zei’s shoulders sink in a silent groan. Bai’s teasing half-smile returns. They resume walking; their reflections slip together out of the window frame. No kiss or reciprocal confession.

shots.heading: 11  ·  78–84
shots.direction: Clean end card over the empty street: The Surplus / An unofficial Snowmoon adaptation / Vitalik Buterin · Chapter 5 · GPLv3. One soft musical resolution; fade at 84 seconds.

cues.speaker: Bai
cues.subtitle:
You came all this way
to keep an eye on me?

cues.speaker: Zei
cues.subtitle:
If I stop practising,
you get ahead.

cues.speaker: Zei
cues.subtitle:
If we stop together,
neither of us falls behind.

cues.speaker: Bai
cues.subtitle:
You make a holiday
sound exhausting.
